common.comingSoon: This section is built in a later bucket.

auth.signUpSubtitle: One account per studio. You can invite your team later.
auth.name: Your name

onboarding.title: Set up your studio
onboarding.subtitle: One pass. You can change any of this later in Settings.
onboarding.studioNameHelp: Shown on every document you generate.
onboarding.logoHelp: PNG or JPG. Appears on your booking page and documents.

settings.title: Settings
settings.studioProfileHelp: Your branding and contact details. These appear on client-facing pages and generated documents.
settings.preferencesHelp: Theme and language are yours alone. Currency and code prefix apply to the whole studio.
settings.studioDefaultsHelp: What a new team member starts with.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the studio owner can change these.

lists.title: Lists
lists.help: The lead statuses and sources used across your pipeline. Rename them to match how your studio actually works.
lists.deleteBlocked: This status is used by {count} contacts, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead — it stays on the records that already use it, but stops appearing in dropdowns.
lists.deleteConfirm: Delete this permanently? Nothing is using it.

leads.title: Leads
leads.empty: No leads yet. Add your first one, or import a CSV.
leads.convertedNotice: {name} booked a consultation and is now a client.

clients.title: Clients
clients.empty: No clients yet. Convert a lead to create your first one.

contact.convertHint: Set the status to a booked one to turn this lead into a client. Booking the consultation is what makes someone a client.
contact.revertTitle: Move this client back to Leads?
contact.revertBody: {name} is a client because their status is a booked one. Changing it to a status that is not returns them to the Leads views and clears their conversion date.
contact.revertLaterWarning: Nothing else is attached to them yet. Once projects, documents and payments exist, this will affect those too — so use it to correct a mistake, not as a normal step.
contact.notePlaceholder: What was said? What was agreed?
contact.noNotes: No notes yet. The first one you add becomes this client's history.
contact.notFound: That contact does not exist, or is not in your workspace.

validation.phoneCodeInvalid: That country code is not valid.
validation.phoneNumberInvalid: That phone number does not look right.
validation.emailInvalid: That email address is not valid.
validation.duplicateEmail: Heads up: {name} already uses this email. Saving anyway is fine.

csv.title: Import leads from CSV
csv.fileHelp: The first row must be the column headings.
csv.mapHelp: Tell us which of your columns holds each field. Leave a field as “Ignore” to skip it.
csv.previewHelp: First {count} rows, as they will be imported.
csv.skippedHelp: These rows were not imported. Fix them in your file and import again.
csv.emptyFile: That file has no data rows.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: {count} templates. Each one exists in Arabic and English, paired together.
templates.checklistsEmpty: Stage checklists are seeded in Bucket 4.
templates.notYetAvailable: {count} of these need projects or bookings, which arrive in a later bucket. They will show as [[markers]] until then.
templates.insertFieldHelp: Pick a field — never type the braces by hand.
templates.questionnaireHelp: Sections tied to a room (kitchen, laundry, ensuite, bathrooms) will be shown or hidden per project once projects exist. For now every section is generated.
templates.resetHelp: Restores the seeded templates to how they shipped. Templates you created yourself are not touched.
templates.resetConfirm: Restore all seeded templates? Any edits you made to them will be lost. Templates you created yourself are kept.
templates.checklistEditNotice: Editing this changes future projects only. Projects already running keep the copy they were created with.

generator.title: Generate document
generator.pickContactHelp: The document is filled with this person's real data.
generator.searchContact: Search by name, email or phone
generator.promptHelp: These are not stored anywhere — they are specific to this document, so I need them from you.
generator.previewHelp: Click into the document to edit it. What you export is what you see.
generator.whatsappHelp: Plain text, no formatting, line breaks kept.
generator.unresolvedBody: These appear as [[markers]] in the document. Fill them on the left, or edit them out before you send.
generator.notAvailableYet: not available until a later bucket
generator.pdfHint: Your browser's print dialog opens — choose “Save as PDF”.

documents.empty: Nothing generated for this client yet.

project.emptyActive: No active projects. Create one from here or from a client's card.
project.noneForContact: No projects for this client yet.
project.notFound: That project does not exist, or is not in your workspace.
project.clientHelp: Pick who this project belongs to.
project.name: Project name
project.requirementsHelp: What the client actually wants. Merges into documents as {{project_description}}.
project.codeNote: The project code is generated automatically and never reused.
project.noChecklist: This stage has no checklist yet. Add items to its template in Templates.
project.noMessages: No message templates are tagged for this stage.
project.gateMet: The gate is satisfied. This stage can be closed.
project.gateBlocking: {count} thing(s) still blocking the next stage.
project.neverCloses: Follow-up never closes. It runs for as long as the relationship does.
project.overrideHelp: The gate is not satisfied. An override is permanent and stays visible on the project timeline, so write down why.
project.overridePlaceholder: Why are you moving past this gate?

booking.setupSubtitle: Everything that shapes your public booking page.
booking.linkHelp: Share this with clients. It works without any login.
booking.isActiveHelp: Turn it off and the link stops working.
booking.availabilityHelp: Tick the days you take consultations and set the hours, in your own timezone.
booking.noticeHelp: Nobody can book sooner than this.
booking.horizonHelp: How far into the future the page offers slots.
booking.timezoneHelp: Slots are shown to clients in this timezone, labelled with it.
booking.blockedHelp: Days you are away. No slots are offered on these.
booking.sessionTypesHelp: What a client can book, and what each costs.
booking.questionsHelp: Asked on the booking page. The answers land in the project.
booking.inboxEmpty: No bookings yet. Share your link to get the first one.
booking.selectOne: Choose a booking to see it.
booking.paymentHelp: No payment gateway. You issue an invoice, the client transfers manually and uploads a receipt, and you confirm it.
booking.awaitingReceipt: Waiting for the client to upload a transfer receipt.
booking.receiptConfirmed: Payment confirmed. The booking is confirmed.
booking.autoFiled: {count} documents were prepared from this booking automatically — the confirmation script and the prep sheet, filed under the client's documents.
